Added 2026-07-15 after the image-vs-controlImage slot postmortem (qa/evidence/gemini-restyle/FLUX_ROOTCAUSE.md): a compacted agent reconstructed API calls from memory and silently swapped the ControlNet slot for the img2img slot, producing hours of misdiagnosed 'regression'. The crypt base_prompt is the byte-repro-verified v3.5 winner (job_fxTssiHBxHfkSnf8TtAqjKs5; base asset_nLpb, md5 05a32d314fca at seed 12345 cs0.85).

Keep the exact same isometric dimetric camera. Do NOT introduce any repeated, cloned, or tiled decorative motifs. Do NOT add any text, letters, numbers, labels, legends, map insets, UI elements, frames, or borders. Do NOT add any characters, people, figures, or creatures. The dark area outside the room walls stays dark empty background — add nothing there, no bones, objects, or debris outside the room. Do NOT add any staircases, steps, balconies, galleries, railings, mezzanines, or upper floors ANYWHERE — this is a strictly SINGLE-STOREY room and every empty corner stays an empty corner (measured defect: invented staircases on 3/3 prior rooms). Preserve the EXACT COUNT and PLACEMENT of every architectural feature from the input image: the same number of pillars/columns on the same floor positions, and the same number of wall openings/doorways/arches in the same walls. Do NOT add pillars, columns, doorways, arches, gates, portcullises, niches or alcoves that are not present in the input image; walls that are solid in the input stay unbroken solid. The floor is a SINGLE FLAT LEVEL: no sunken areas, no water channels, cisterns, pools or canals, no staircases DOWN, no pits or lower levels — every floor cell shown in the input stays dry, flat walkable floor in its ORIGINAL material.
